mask_address.ValidationMessage: A CIDR range like 10.0.0.0/8 — the covered bits of IPs in the logs are masked (e.g. 192.168.1.200 -> 192.x.x.x).

tun_ipv6_address.ValidationMessage: IPv6 unique-local prefix, e.g. fd00::1/64 (ULA only, link-local fe80:: is auto-assigned and cannot be entered here). Leave empty to disable IPv6 on the TUN.

tun_auto_outbounds_interface.ValidationMessage: Empty disables outbound interface binding. "auto" or an interface name (e.g. vmx1) binds Xray's outbound sockets so they cannot loop back through the TUN. On FreeBSD this needs net.fibs=2 in /boot/loader.conf and a reboot; with net.fibs=1 (the OPNsense default) Xray fails to start and this plugin refuses to apply. On Linux/macOS this works out of the box.

OptionValues.fakedns: FakeDNS (returns fake IPs; see the FakeDNS docs)

sniffing_domains_excluded.ValidationMessage: Comma-separated domain rules (router rules syntax) to exclude from sniffing, e.g. geosite:category-ads-all, domain:example.com.

socks_password.ValidationMessage: Password up to 128 characters, no control characters.

socks_listen.ValidationMessage: Enter a valid IPv4 address, for example 127.0.0.1.

http_listen.ValidationMessage: IPv4 address to bind the HTTP proxy, or leave empty to reuse the SOCKS listen address.

http_password.ValidationMessage: Password up to 128 characters, no control characters.

dns_json.ValidationMessage: DNS must be a JSON object, e.g. {"servers": ["https://1.1.1.1/dns-query"]}.

balancers_json.ValidationMessage: Balancers must be a JSON array, e.g. [{"tag": "auto", "selector": ["node_"], "strategy": {"type": "leastPing"}}].

observatory_json.ValidationMessage: Observatory must be a JSON object, e.g. {"burstObservatory": {"subjectSelector": ["node_"]}}.

OptionValues.none: Disabled (use the Raw JSON field below, if set)

observatory_url.ValidationMessage: Enter an https:// URL (letters, digits and . _ ~ : / ? = % + @ - only).

observatory_interval.ValidationMessage: Enter a duration such as 10s, 1m or 1h.

observatory_timeout.ValidationMessage: Enter a duration such as 5s or 1m.

observatory_http_method.ValidationMessage: Use GET, HEAD or leave empty (Xray default: HEAD).

dns_hosts_json.ValidationMessage: Hosts must be a JSON object, e.g. {"dns.google": "8.8.8.8", "example.com": "192.0.2.10", "*.internal": ["192.0.2.11"]}.

OptionValues.IPIfNonMatch: IPIfNonMatch — resolve only when domains fail to match (default)
OptionValues.IPOnDemand: IPOnDemand — resolve only when an IP rule needs it

name.ValidationMessage: Node name must be 1-64 characters (letters, digits, spaces, and common punctuation).

address.ValidationMessage: Enter a valid hostname, IPv4 or IPv6 address (max 253 characters, no scheme or spaces).

user_uuid.ValidationMessage: Value must be 1-256 printable characters without control characters.

auth_user.ValidationMessage: Username must be 1-255 printable characters without control characters.

auth_pass.ValidationMessage: Password must be 1-255 printable characters without control characters.

http_headers.ValidationMessage: Must be a JSON object, e.g. {"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}.

encryption.ValidationMessage: Encryption must be 1-512 printable characters (use "none" for standard VLESS).

extra.ValidationMessage: VLESS extra settings must be valid JSON up to 8192 characters.

vmess_experiments.ValidationMessage: Use only AuthenticatedLength and/or NoTerminationSignal, separated by "|".

sni.ValidationMessage: Enter a valid SNI hostname (max 253 characters, no scheme, spaces or wildcards).

tls_ech_config_list.ValidationMessage: ECH config list must be printable ASCII (up to 16384 characters).

tls_pinned_peer_cert_sha256.ValidationMessage: Pinned peer certificate SHA-256 must be one or more 64-char hex digests, comma-separated.

tls_verify_peer_cert_by_name.ValidationMessage: Verification names must be comma-separated hostnames (wildcards allowed).

tls_min_version.ValidationMessage: Minimum TLS version must be 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 or 1.3.

tls_max_version.ValidationMessage: Maximum TLS version must be 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 or 1.3.

reality_pubkey.ValidationMessage: REALITY public key must be 43 base64url characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, -, _).

reality_shortid.ValidationMessage: REALITY ShortId must be 1-8 bytes as hex (2-16 characters, even length).

reality_spiderx.ValidationMessage: SpiderX must start with "/" and contain no spaces.

reality_mldsa65_verify.ValidationMessage: ML-DSA-65 verification key must be base64url characters.

transport_host.ValidationMessage: Enter a valid host or host:port (max 253 characters, no scheme or spaces).

transport_path.ValidationMessage: Path must start with "/", contain no spaces and be at most 1024 characters.

grpc_service_name.ValidationMessage: gRPC service name may contain only letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen (max 255).

grpc_authority.ValidationMessage: gRPC authority may contain only letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore, colon and brackets (max 253).

grpc_user_agent.ValidationMessage: gRPC user agent must be up to 512 printable characters.

grpc_idle_timeout.ValidationMessage: gRPC idle timeout must be a non-negative integer (seconds).

grpc_health_check_timeout.ValidationMessage: gRPC health check timeout must be a non-negative integer (seconds).

grpc_initial_windows_size.ValidationMessage: gRPC initial windows size must be a non-negative integer.

xhttp_extra.ValidationMessage: XHTTP extra must be a JSON object, e.g. {"scMaxEachPostBytes":1000000}.

ws_heartbeat_period.ValidationMessage: WebSocket heartbeat period must be a non-negative integer (seconds).

xdrive_remote_folder.ValidationMessage: XDRIVE remote folder must be up to 1024 printable characters.

xdrive_google_client_id.ValidationMessage: Google OAuth client ID must be up to 4096 printable characters.

xdrive_google_client_secret.ValidationMessage: Google OAuth client secret must be up to 4096 printable characters.

xdrive_google_refresh_token.ValidationMessage: Google OAuth refresh token must be up to 4096 printable characters.

xdrive_s3_endpoint.ValidationMessage: S3 endpoint must be an http:// or https:// URL.

xdrive_s3_region.ValidationMessage: S3 region may contain only letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen (max 64).

xdrive_s3_bucket.ValidationMessage: S3 bucket may contain only letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen (max 255).

xdrive_s3_access_key.ValidationMessage: S3 access key ID must be up to 4096 printable characters.

xdrive_s3_secret_key.ValidationMessage: S3 secret access key must be up to 4096 printable characters.

xdrive_s3_session_token.ValidationMessage: S3 session token must be up to 4096 printable characters.

xdrive_template_secrets.ValidationMessage: Template secrets must be a JSON array, e.g. ["token0","token1"].

xdrive_template.ValidationMessage: XDRIVE template must be a JSON object, e.g. {"auth":{...},"put":{...}}.

xdrive_extra.ValidationMessage: XDRIVE extra must be a JSON object (segmentBytes, flushIntervalMs, pollIntervalMs, sessionTtlSeconds, concurrency, eagerWindowMs, holeTimeoutMs, xmux, ...).

mux_concurrency.ValidationMessage: Mux concurrency must be an integer between -1 and 128.

email.ValidationMessage: Email must be up to 256 printable characters.

sockopt_dialer_proxy.ValidationMessage: Dialer proxy must be an outbound tag (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen, max 64).

sockopt_interface.ValidationMessage: Interface name must be letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen (max 32).

sockopt_mark.ValidationMessage: SO_MARK must be a non-negative integer.

sockopt_tcp_congestion.ValidationMessage: TCP congestion control must be a lowercase algorithm name (e.g. bbr, cubic, reno).

sockopt_tcp_keepalive_idle.ValidationMessage: TCP keepalive idle must be an integer number of seconds (negative disables default).

sockopt_tcp_keepalive_interval.ValidationMessage: TCP keepalive interval must be an integer number of seconds (negative disables default).

sockopt_tcp_user_timeout.ValidationMessage: TCP user timeout must be a non-negative integer number of milliseconds.

send_through.ValidationMessage: Send Through must be an IPv4 address, origin, or srcip.

finalmask.ValidationMessage: FinalMask must be a valid JSON object.

custom_stream_json.ValidationMessage: Must be a JSON object (starts with { and ends with }).

wg_secret_key.ValidationMessage: WireGuard key must be 44 base64 characters (32 bytes + padding "=").

wg_public_key.ValidationMessage: WireGuard key must be 44 base64 characters (32 bytes + padding "=").

wg_preshared_key.ValidationMessage: WireGuard key must be 44 base64 characters (32 bytes + padding "=").

wg_endpoint.ValidationMessage: Enter peer endpoint as host:port, e.g. example.com:51820 (IPv6: [2001:db8::1]:51820).

wg_address.ValidationMessage: Each entry must be an IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR, e.g. 10.0.0.1 or fd00::1/128. Prefix length is checked by Xray on apply.

wg_allowed_ips.ValidationMessage: Each entry must be an IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR, e.g. 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. Prefix length is checked by Xray on apply.

wg_keepalive.ValidationMessage: Persistent keepalive must be an integer between 0 and 65535 seconds.

wg_mtu.ValidationMessage: Inner MTU must be an integer between 1280 and 9000.

wg_reserved.ValidationMessage: Reserved bytes must be exactly three numbers 0-255 separated by commas, e.g. 0,0,0.

wg_remote_dns.ValidationMessage: Each DNS server must be an IPv4 or IPv6 address.

freedom_final_rules.ValidationMessage: Must be a JSON array, e.g. [{"action":"block","network":"tcp","port":"25,465"}].

dns_rewrite_address.ValidationMessage: Enter a valid hostname, IPv4 or IPv6 address.

dns_rewrite_port.ValidationMessage: Enter a port number 1-65535 or leave empty.

dns_rules_json.ValidationMessage: Must be a JSON array, e.g. [{"action":"return","rCode":3}].

loopback_inbound_tag.ValidationMessage: Inbound tag must be 1-64 printable characters without control characters.

hysteria_auth.ValidationMessage: Hysteria auth must be 1-256 printable characters without control characters.

hysteria_udp_idle_timeout.ValidationMessage: UDP idle timeout must be an integer between 1 and 3600 seconds.

masque_host.ValidationMessage: Enter a valid host or host:port (max 253 characters), e.g. example.com:443.

masque_path.ValidationMessage: MASQUE path must start with "/" and contain both {target} and {ipproto} placeholders.

masque_remote_dns.ValidationMessage: Each DNS server must be an IPv4 or IPv6 address.

inbound_tag.ValidationMessage: Comma-separated inbound tags, e.g. tun-in, socks-in. Only traffic from those inbounds matches this rule.

source.ValidationMessage: Comma-separated source addresses/CIDRs or geoip: tags, e.g. 192.168.0.0/16, geoip:private. Only LAN/TUN-routed traffic carries the real source IP; NAT'd sources appear as the NAT address.

user.ValidationMessage: Comma-separated user names of the SOCKS/HTTP inbounds (auth users). Useful for forcing one user through a node.

rule_tag.ValidationMessage: Optional tag for this rule (1-64 characters), shown in Xray stats for the rule.

tag.ValidationMessage: Tag must be 1-64 characters (letters, digits, _ . -); direct, block and api are reserved, and node_ is the prefix of node tags.

selector.ValidationMessage: Each selector must be a tag prefix, e.g. node_ (1-64 characters).

fallback_tag.ValidationMessage: Fallback tag must be direct, block, a node tag or another balancer tag (1-64 characters).

address.ValidationMessage: Server address: https://1.1.1.1/dns-query, https+local://1.1.1.1/dns-query (direct), tcp://dns1.yandex.ru, fakedns or localhost.

port.ValidationMessage: Optional port (1-65535). Leave empty for the scheme default (DoH 443, plain DNS 53).

domains.ValidationMessage: Comma-separated domain rules, e.g. geosite:ru, domain:ya.ru, full:example.com. Empty serves all domains.

expected_ips.ValidationMessage: Comma-separated CIDRs or geoip: tags, e.g. geoip:ru, 192.168.0.0/16. * means "any accepted" (default).

unexpected_ips.ValidationMessage: Comma-separated CIDRs or geoip: tags; answers containing any of them are rejected (e.g. geoip:ir to keep IR answers out of an RU server).

plugin_branch.ValidationMessage: Branch name may contain only letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.

custom_geoip_url.ValidationMessage: Enter an https:// URL (letters, digits and . _ ~ : / ? = % + @ - only).

custom_geosite_url.ValidationMessage: Enter an https:// URL (letters, digits and . _ ~ : / ? = % + @ - only).
